Mise à jour CRITIQUE du CSS pour l'accessibilité et la lisibilité (Cible : Dirigeants 50+).
Objectif : Rendre le texte parfaitement lisible sans sacrifier l'élégance. Le design doit rester aéré mais les caractères doivent être plus gros et plus contrastés.

INSTRUCTIONS DE DESIGN (CSS) :

1. ÉCHELLE TYPOGRAPHIQUE (AUGMENTATION) :
- Texte courant (Body / Paragraphes) : Passe la taille minimale à 18px (au lieu de 14/16px).
- Petits textes (Légendes, Notes, Italiques) : Jamais en dessous de 14px. (12px est interdit).
- Titres H3 (Cartes) : Augmente à 24px pour une lecture immédiate.

2. POIDS DE LA FONTE (WEIGHT) :
- Remplace toutes les polices "Light" (font-weight: 300) par "Regular" (font-weight: 400).
- Sur fond sombre (Vert Oxford), le texte blanc/beige paraît plus fin optiquement. Passe-le en "Medium" (font-weight: 500) si nécessaire pour qu'il soit bien net.

3. CONTRASTE & COULEURS :
- Textes sur fond sombre : Assure-toi que le gris n'est pas trop foncé. Utilise un Blanc Cassé (#F4F6F7) ou un Beige Clair (#F0EAD6) pour maximiser le contraste.
- Textes sur fond clair : Utilise le Vert Oxford (#152822) ou un Gris Anthracite (#2C3E50), jamais de gris pâle.

4. ESPACEMENT (RESPIRATION) :
- Augmente la hauteur de ligne (line-height) à 1.6 ou 1.7 pour que les lignes de texte ne se chevauchent pas visuellement.
- Ajoute un peu plus de padding (espace) autour des blocs de texte pour compenser l'agrandissement de la police.

APPLIQUE CES RÈGLES SUR TOUTES LES PAGES GÉNÉRÉES (Risque, Système, Data, Accueil).

**Focusing the Sales Pitch**

I've been working on refining the "ImpactRisque" page into a compelling sales landing page for the "Audit de Robustesse" and "Audit Blanc" offerings. I'm currently focused on incorporating the detailed content instructions. I'm aiming to craft compelling headlines, benefit-driven bullet points, and persuasive CTAs to maximize conversion.


**Updating the Value Prop**

I'm now revising the "prevention" card with the new title "PRÉVENTION (AUDIT)".  I've incorporated the bold emphasis for "Audit de Robustesse" and "Audit Blanc". I'm also preparing to integrate the "projection" block, with the -300,000€ in bold dark red, and the hypothesis note in medium gray, 12px, italic.


**Prioritizing Accessibility Tweaks**

I'm now focusing on accessibility and readability updates, specifically targeting the 50+ demographic. This means adjusting global CSS rules: bumping up the minimum body text to 18px and small text to 14px (not 12px, despite the conflicting instruction). I'm also ensuring proper font weights (400 Regular, or 500 Medium for white on dark backgrounds) and line heights (1.6 or 1.7) for optimal viewing. This accessibility update trumps the previous instruction for the hypothesis note at 12px, as the global CSS rules are explicitly labelled as a priority.


**Updating the Final Touches**

I'm now implementing the final changes to the ImpactRisque page, focusing on both content and design.  I've revised the call to action, creating a more compelling title and button text.  Additionally, I've implemented the 1-10-100 section with horizontal alignment, arrows, and an emphasized shadow on the 100€ card. The typography scale is also updated in the global CSS, ensuring proper font weights and line heights for optimal readability.  I'm now reviewing `index.html` to finalize these changes in my components.


**Refining Global Styling**

I'm now focusing on global CSS updates for readability across all generated pages. I'm updating `index.html`'s Tailwind config to reflect the new font sizes: 14px for meta, 18px for base, and 16px for small text. I'll replace all 'font-light' with 'font-normal' to boost contrast.


**Improving Global CSS Rules**

I'm now streamlining the CSS adjustments to meet readability goals across all generated pages. My focus is on updating the Tailwind configuration to map `font-light` to `font-normal` (400 weight). This avoids manual edits across multiple files and ensures a unified style across the site, aligning with the prompt's instruction. Furthermore, I'll update all the other files to incorporate the styling fixes for readability that were discussed, as a final pass.


**Optimizing Font Weights**

I'm now implementing the font weight changes globally. Based on the instructions, I'm replacing all instances of `font-light` with `font-normal` via find/replace to ensure all pages are consistent. I'm also scanning for white text on dark backgrounds and marking them with `font-medium` to boost contrast, as instructed. Finally, I'll incorporate the new font size tweaks across the project, including updated sizes in `index.html`.


**Completing Global Refactoring**

I've completed global CSS updates, implementing all font weight adjustments and ensuring readability throughout. I have also finished refactoring the font sizes, ensuring a minimum size of 14px and implementing font weights for text on dark backgrounds. I'm now verifying these changes across all pages, including `ImpactSysteme.tsx`, `ImpactData.tsx`, and `Home.tsx`.


**Integrating CSS Updates**

I'm now integrating the final CSS adjustments. I'll modify `index.html` to reflect the Tailwind config changes, specifically font sizes. I'll also implement horizontal card alignment and add arrows and an emphasized shadow to the 100€ card in the "ImpactRisque" view. I'm focusing on consistency in font weights and text sizes throughout, including the changes previously mentioned.


**Finalizing Accessibility Adjustments**

I'm now implementing the 14px minimum text size as instructed. To maintain Tailwind's class structure, I'm redefining the `text-xs` class in `index.html` to be 14px. I've updated `views/ImpactRisque.tsx`, removing the conflicting `font-light` class, and ensuring the arrow logic is correct. Accessibility updates will be made in `views/ImpactSysteme.tsx`, `views/ImpactData.tsx`, and `views/Home.tsx`. I'll prioritize these pages to comply with the prompt's focus. I'm also ensuring the CSS is updated on all pages, including `views/Services.tsx`, `views/About.tsx`, `views/Method.tsx`, `views/Contact.tsx`, and `views/Legal.tsx`.


**Finalizing Global Adjustments**

I'm now concluding the accessibility and styling overhaul. I've focused on replacing all `font-light` instances with `font-normal` (or removing it if default) across all the provided files. I've also incorporated `font-medium` on dark backgrounds to ensure contrast, and will be verifying that the font sizes are consistent. I'm prioritizing the implementation of the 14px minimum font size, particularly in `ImpactRisque`. I'm also addressing the arrow logic on that page to correctly represent the relationship between cards 1 and 2, and 2 and 3, ensuring responsive design. I'm also ensuring the -300,000€ text is the correct font size. I'm now testing the updates and incorporating the updates across the pages.


**Finalizing Global Readability**

I'm now putting the finishing touches on ensuring global readability. I'm focusing on consistency: making sure `font-normal` is applied where it needs to be, and updating font sizes based on my `index.html` updates. I've confirmed that the minimum text size across all pages is now 14px, and that the text contrast looks good. I'm working to make sure the hero text size is sufficient on `Home.tsx`. I'll be reviewing the code to ensure that all accessibility guidelines are met.


**Coding the ImpactRisque Page**

I'm now fully immersed in coding the `ImpactRisque` page, incorporating all the requested updates. I've updated card content, bolded key terms, adjusted text sizes, and implemented the arrows between cards. The shadow effect on the 100€ card is adjusted for emphasis. I'm focusing on ensuring proper alignment and responsiveness. I'm prioritizing the listed pages, but I've quickly checked the `Services.tsx` page to ensure accessibility guidelines.

I'm currently working to integrate the updates into `Home.tsx`. I'll be starting by implementing the adjustments to the `index.html` file. I'm focusing on refining the typography, and will also update the home page to accommodate the new styling changes. I'll make sure to add `font-medium` to `text-white` elements where it is needed.
